measurement_scope: Local Linux paced simulation method validation; not native Windows acceptance evidence
command: cargo run --release -p auralis-cli -- simulate 2 --denoiser ul-unas --model models/ulunas_stream_simple.onnx

method.name: same-process RSS delta before and after denoiser load
method.interpretation: The delta includes the model, inference runtime, and persistent adapter allocations; it excludes stream processing after load and is not a weight-only byte count.

limitations: The host is Linux/WSL, not the native Windows production host.
RSS delta is an isolated load-envelope measurement, not a model-weight allocation query.
